name: Persistence via scheduled task
summary: PowerShell execution followed by scheduled-task persistence, each step an Atomic Red Team test. Trainees hunt the PowerShell activity and the task it leads to.
objectives: Find the PowerShell execution and its parent process.
Find the scheduled task that was created, its action, and who created it.
Tie the two steps together on a timeline.
notes: Before first use: on the lab host, open the Scenario builder, pick one T1059.001 test and one T1053.005 test from the catalog (this sets atomic_guid), review the input arguments and the exact command, set the verify check to the task name the chosen test creates, enter expected detections and hunt notes, then save.
atomic_guid is deliberately empty in the repo: tests are chosen from the ART version installed on the lab host.

steps.title: Execution via PowerShell
hunt_notes: Start from powershell.exe process events on {{Host}} in the step's UTC window and look at the parent process and command line.

steps.title: Persistence via scheduled task
hunt_notes: Look for the task registration (schtasks.exe or the Task Scheduler API) and pivot to the task's action and the process that created it.
